d: Anti-government demonstrations in France have intensified, with Paris witnessing fresh clashes between riot police and protesters amid growing anger over the rising cost of living under President Emmanuel Macron's government. The latest protests brought together Yellow Vest activists, trade unions and student groups, with demands centred on higher wages, affordable housing and improved public services. Police operations around Place de la Nation have drawn attention to the use of tear gas, stun grenades and other crowd-control measures. Watch.
